announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: As a micro-cap AIM-listed entity with historically low liquidity and limited analyst coverage, this interim report provides essential visibility into operational cash flow and debt servicing capabilities, which are critical for assessing survival risk in the current high-interest-rate environment.

announcements.headline: Result of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: Routine AGM results typically confirm standard shareholder approvals for directors' remuneration and auditor appointments, offering no new strategic direction or capital allocation signals for S-Ventures Plc.
